name: Hunting in Stranglethorn
summary: You carry Roon Wildmane's token north of Grom'gol Base Camp to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn. The tauren and dwarf once hunted together in Desolace.

sections.title: A Token Between Hunters
sections.body:
Roon Wildmane remembers hunting beside Hemet, a dwarf who came to Desolace to hunt great beasts. Hemet wielded a rifle with uncanny skill. For many days, the two hunted together and set aside the old enmity between their peoples.

When Hemet left for Stranglethorn, Roon vowed to welcome him back for another hunt. Now Roon sends you with his kodo horn, a token Hemet will recognize. Find Hemet in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol Base Camp.

sections.title: Hemet's Answer
sections.body: Hemet recognizes Roon Wildmane's kodo horn at once. He remembers the good hunting they shared among the beasts of Desolace and thanks you, though he is neck deep in the jungle for now. Hemet thinks his next expedition may lead back to Desolace, where the centaurs live.

faq.answer: Hemet is a dwarf who came to Desolace to hunt great beasts. His rifle skill was uncanny, and he and Roon Wildmane hunted together for many days before Hemet left for Stranglethorn.

faq.q: Why does Roon Wildmane care about a dwarf?
faq.answer: Roon Wildmane and Hemet hunted together for many days, setting aside the enmity between their peoples. Roon vowed to welcome Hemet back so they could hunt again.
Hemet is in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol Base Camp.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the kodo horn?
faq.answer: Roon Wildmane sends the kodo horn to Hemet, who will recognize it as Roon's.
